_comment: Repaired MelusinaLocomotion state machine for ABP_Melusina_Current.
4 states -- Idle, JumpStart, Airborne, Land -- and NO ground-locomotion state.
BS_Melusina_Locomotion is not referenced by the AnimGraph at all. That is why walk/run
never triggers: there is nothing for velocity to drive. The T-pose is the same wound one
layer up -- the entry Idle state resolves to no sequence, so it emits the reference pose.
The INITIAL HOLD of SpaceBar must trigger the wind-up animation. The launch does not
happen on press. Press -> bJumpWindup=true -> JumpWindup state plays the anticipation
crouch -> the AnimNotify 'JumpLaunch' inside that clip calls Jump() -> Airborne.
This is why the entry rule is bJumpWindup and NOT bIsFalling: keying off IsFalling would
mean the wind-up can only start after the character has already left the ground.
_LIVE_PREFLIGHT_2026-08-16: Preflight against the live ABP changed this spec. Two things the committed export
1. A 'Glide' state exists (position [192,0]). The export baseline has only 4 states.
The first draft computed stale = existing - spec and would have DELETED Glide,
bRequireCapabilityProviderForGlide=true, and the ABP has a bIsGliding variable).
2. Speed / Velocity / Acceleration / bIsMoving / bIsGliding / WasInAir already exist.
11 variables total. The locomotion plumbing is already wired -- only the state
So this plan is now PURELY ADDITIVE. Nothing is removed. 'JumpStart' is repurposed as
the wind-up rather than replaced by a new 'JumpWindup' state, which preserves the
existing Idle -> JumpStart -> Airborne -> Land chain and its transitions.

bJumpWindup.source: BP_MelusinaJRPGCharacter: true on MelodiaTraversalJump Pressed, false on Landed or Released

states.name: Idle
states._note: REVISED. The first draft bound A_Melusina_Idle (unsuffixed, 2026-08-08), which would likely have preserved the T-pose rather than fixed it. melusina_idle_restore_mocap_2026-08-13.md names A_Melusina_Idle_Mocap_RootX as the owner-approved speed-0 idle and records the previous sample as a collapsed/wrong pose. Length 0.5s, loops, correct cm scale via the mocap retargeter chain.
_tpose_hypotheses: A: state graph resolves to no sequence -> reference pose (original theory)
B: state IS bound, but to a bad Lane A clip that evaluates to rest pose (now the stronger theory, given the 08-08 asset was wired in after the 08-13 mocap restore)
Preflight distinguishes them: if the Idle state already has a sequence player, it is B.

states.name: Locomotion
states._note: The missing state. This is the fix for walk/run not triggering.

states.name: JumpWindup
states._note: Anticipation crouch. always_reset_on_entry is required or a re-press mid-clip resumes from the middle instead of restarting the wind-up.

transitions._note: 0.05s. The wind-up must read as instant on the press or the hold feels dead.
Fires only after the JumpLaunch notify has called Jump(). Not time-based.
Landing at speed must resume locomotion. The baseline only had Land -> Idle, which stalls a running landing.

notifies.name: JumpLaunch
notifies._note: Placement is provisional -- retime against the clip's actual push-off frame once it can be scrubbed in-editor. Consumed by BP_MelusinaJRPGCharacter to call Jump().

foot_ik.placement: after the state machine, before the KawaiiPhysics nodes
foot_ik._note: IK_Melusina/IK_Melusina_Body currently have zero solvers and zero goals, which also makes the retargeter's 'Run IK Rig' op inert.
